**Adversarial Review – Q220 Narrative‑Structured XBRL Representation Gap**  

---

### Findings  

| # | Failure Mode (as‑filed XBRL) | Minimal Deterministic Falsifier | Exact Artifact Needed |
|---|------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------|
| 1 | **Text‑block ↔ Presentation‑role mapping missing** – `txt.txt/tsv` entries have no guaranteed counterpart in `pre.txt/tsv` with matching context/section identity. | Load `txt.tsv` and `pre.tsv`. Build a map keyed by `(filing_id, context_ref)`. Assert `∀ t ∈ txt : ∃ p ∈ pre` where keys match. Fail if any `t` lacks a matching `p`. | `txt.tsv`, `pre.tsv` (full archive) |
| 2 | **Taxonomy‑extension changes not captured** – Custom namespaces or extensions that affect narrative rendering are not validated. | Enumerate all namespace URIs referenced in the raw XBRL facts (e.g., `*.xml` inside the zip). Flag any URI not in the known core taxonomy set. | Raw XBRL fact files (`*.xml`) from the 2009Q1 archive |
| 3 | **Custom namespaces not verified** – Expected custom namespace definitions (e.g., `us-gaap:`) may be missing or altered. | Load any taxonomy files (`*.xsd`, `*.xml`) present in the archive. Validate that required custom namespace URIs are declared and that their element/attribute definitions match the frozen contract. | Taxonomy files (`*.xsd`, `*.xml`) from the archive |
| 4 | **Section identity not preserved** – Narrative tokens may lose section identifiers (MD&A, footnotes, etc.). | Parse `txt.tsv` for section markers (e.g., column `section_id`). Verify that each marker appears in a corresponding `pre.tsv` entry with the same `section_id`. Fail if mismatches >0. | `txt.tsv`, `pre.tsv` |
| 5 | **Narrative tokenization quality unchecked** – Text blocks may be incorrectly split, losing sentence boundaries. | Apply a deterministic tokenizer (e.g., `nltk.word_tokenize` with a fixed seed) to each `txt` field. Compare token count and boundaries against a reference tokenization (if available) or flag any token that contains XML/HTML tags. | `txt.tsv` |
| 6 | **Amended filings not filtered** – Archive may contain `.A` or amendment filings that should be excluded. | Scan filing identifiers (e.g., `accessionNumber` in metadata) for amendment suffixes (`.A`, `.A1`, etc.). Exclude those rows from any analysis. | Filing metadata (e.g., `sub.txt` or accompanying CSV) |
| 7 | **Future/current XBRL contamination** – Facts with periods outside the trial window (`FIXED_END`) are not filtered. | Extract `period` from each fact (if present). Discard any fact where `period > FIXED_END`. Fail if any retained fact violates this. | Raw XBRL facts (`*.xml`) |
| 8 | **Duplicate facts not deduplicated** – Same entity/period/concept/unit/context may appear multiple times. | Build composite key `(entity, period, concept, unit, context)`. Flag duplicates where key repeats across files. | Raw XBRL facts (`
